description: Verified Victorian plumbing & roofing regulatory register. Each value is a verbatim or directly-quotable fact from the cited authoritative government / regulator / standards-body page, confirmed by a live fetch on the date in verified.on.

entries.claim: BPC-mandated stormwater drainage edition is AS/NZS 3500.3:2025
entries.fails_if: page names a different edition or a newer amendment; standard not stated as current

verified.quote: AS/NZS 3500.3:2025 On 17 April 2025, Standards Australia published AS/NZS 3500:2025 plumbing and drainage to replace the 2021 edition.

entries.claim: Valley-gutter deemed-to-satisfy catchment limit increased from 20 m² to 40 m² (Clause 3.6.1, 2025 edition)
entries.fails_if: current edition states a different limit or clause number

verified.quote: Clause 3.6.1 Limitations (Update to clause) ... In the 2025 edition, the limit has increased from 20 m² to 40 m².

entries.claim: Appendix F eaves-gutter overflow design (up to 400 m² catchment, 1% AEP) is now mandatory (normative) in the 2025 edition
entries.fails_if: Appendix F is no longer mandatory, or catchment/AEP figures change

verified.quote: Appendix F has become normative in the 2025 edition, meaning it is now a mandatory requirement. ... Appendix F specifies requirements for design of eaves gutter overflow measures for on roof catchments up to 400 m².

entries.claim: AS/NZS 3500.1:2025 Water services is the current referenced standard for water-supply plumbing work
entries.fails_if: page names a different edition of AS/NZS 3500.1

verified.quote: S/NZS 3500 series Updated plumbing and drainage standards - Part 1: Water services AS/NZS 3500.1:2025 On 17 April 2025, Standards Australia published AS/NZS 3500:2025 plumbing and drainage to replace the 2021 edition. It is a referenced standard

entries.claim: AS/NZS 3500.2:2025 Sanitary plumbing and drainage is the current referenced standard for sanitary work
entries.fails_if: page names a different edition of AS/NZS 3500.2

verified.quote: s Updated plumbing and drainage standards - Part 2: Sanitary plumbing and drainage AS/NZS 3500.2:2025 On 17 April 2025, Standards Australia published AS/NZS 3500:2025 plumbing and drainage to replace the 2021 edition. It is a referenced standard

entries.claim: AS/NZS 3500.4:2025 Heated water services is the current referenced standard for heated-water work
entries.fails_if: page names a different edition of AS/NZS 3500.4

verified.quote: 500 series Updated plumbing and drainage standards - Part 4: Heated water services AS/NZS 3500.4:2025 On 17 April 2025, Standards Australia published AS/NZS 3500:2025 plumbing and drainage to replace the 2021 edition. It is a referenced standard

entries.claim: A plumbing compliance certificate is required where total work value (materials, appliances, labour, GST) exceeds $750
entries.fails_if: threshold figure changes

verified.quote: where the total value of work (including materials, appliances, labour and GST) exceeds $750

entries.claim: Plumbing work in Victoria is governed by the Plumbing Regulations 2018 (instrument page in force on legislation.vic.gov.au)

verified.quote: Plumbing Regulations 2018 | legislation.vic.gov.au

entries.claim: Victorian building & plumbing regulator is the Building and Plumbing Commission (BPC), established 1 July 2025, replacing the VBA
entries.fails_if: regulator identity changes again or establishment date changes

verified.quote: The Building and Plumbing Commission (BPC) - a single, integrated regulator for the building system established on 1 July 2025.

entries.claim: Backflow prevention work is defined under Part 5 of the Plumbing Regulations 2018; field testing per AS/NZS 2845.3
entries.fails_if: Part number or referenced standard changes

verified.quote: Under Part 5 of the Plumbing Regulations 2018, Backflow Prevention work is the repair, alteration, maintenance, testing or commissioning of a backflow prevention device

entries.claim: Gasfitting work is defined under Part 4 of the Plumbing Regulations 2018; includes Type A and Type B gasfitting
entries.fails_if: Part number or Type A/B classification changes

verified.quote: Under Part 4 of the Plumbing Regulations 2018, gasfitting work is defined as the construction, installation, replacement, repair, alteration, maintenance, testing or commissioning

entries.claim: Drainage work (sanitary + stormwater below-ground) is defined under Part 4 of the Plumbing Regulations 2018

verified.quote: Under Part 4 of the Plumbing Regulations 2018, drainage work is the construction, installation, replacement, repair, alteration, maintenance, relining, testing or commissioning

entries.claim: Sanitary work is defined under Part 4 of the Plumbing Regulations 2018
entries.fails_if: Part number or work definition changes

verified.quote: Under Part 4 of the Plumbing Regulations 2018, sanitary work is: the construction, installation, replacement, repair, alteration, maintenance, relining, testing or commissioning

entries.claim: Roofing (stormwater) work is defined under Part 4 of the Plumbing Regulations 2018
entries.fails_if: Part number or work definition changes

entries.claim: Water supply work (drinking & non-drinking) is defined under Part 4 of the Plumbing Regulations 2018
entries.fails_if: Part number or work definition changes

entries.fails_if: registration requirement or process changes

verified.quote: Plumbing registration and licensing | Building and Plumbing Commission --> --> --> Skip to main content Go to BPC Homepage Search BPC Login Menu Log in Log in to BPC Onlin

entries.claim: Hot water must be stored above 60°C (to control Legionella) and delivered via a tempering valve at a lower temperature to prevent scalding (50°C reference)
entries.fails_if: storage/tempering temperature guidance changes

verified.quote: Hot water needs to be stored above 60°C in hot water systems to prevent bacteria growth (such as Legionella), but a tempering valve ensures that the water comes out of the tap at a lower temperature.

entries.claim: WorkSafe falls duties (housing construction) trigger for work above 2 metres, per the OHS Regulations 2017 compliance code
entries.fails_if: height trigger changes

verified.quote: how to control risks associated with falls from more than 2 metres

entries.claim: WorkSafe falls duties (general construction) also apply from more than 2 metres, per the OHS Regulations 2017 compliance code
entries.fails_if: height trigger changes

verified.quote: how to control risks associated with falls from more than 2 metres

entries.claim: Unlicensed non-friable asbestos removal capped at 10 m² total and 1 hour cumulative per 7-day period (OHS Regs 2017, Part 4.4)
entries.fails_if: area cap, time cap, or part number change

verified.quote: the area of asbestos-containing material to be removed does not exceed 10 square metres in total; and the total time taken to perform the asbestos removal work in any seven day period does not exceed one hour.

entries.claim: Under Part VIA of the Dangerous Goods Act 1985, notify WorkSafe of asbestos installed on/after 1 January 2004 (non-domestic); enter agreement within 60 days
entries.fails_if: cutoff date, agreement period, or domestic exemption changes

verified.quote: Notification of asbestos installed on or after 1 January 2004 ... The person must enter into an agreement with WorkSafe within 60 days

entries.claim: Confined-spaces duties arise under Victoria's OHS legislation; WorkSafe publishes a dedicated compliance code for confined-spaces work
entries.fails_if: the compliance code is withdrawn or the OHS-law basis changes

verified.quote: this compliance code provides practical guidance on how to comply with your obligations under Victoria’s occupational health and safety legislation when your work involves confined spaces

entries.claim: No Go Zone for overhead powerline work is within 3.0 m; Spotter Zone is 3.0 m–6.4 m (registered spotter required), per Energy Safe Victoria / OHS Regs 2017
entries.fails_if: the 3.0 m / 6.4 m thresholds or responsible regulator change

verified.quote: Work within 3.0m from an overhead power line, permit ... Work between 3.0m and 6.4m from an overhead power line, a registered Spotter is required.

entries.claim: Implied warranties on domestic building work run up to 10 years from completion (Building Act 1993, per the Domestic Building Contracts Act 1995)
entries.fails_if: warranty period or governing Act reference changes

verified.quote: The Building Act 1993 allows action to be brought against a builder for up to 10 years from the date the work was completed.

entries.claim: Domestic building insurance (DBI) is required on domestic building works over $16,000 (formerly 'builders warranty insurance')
entries.fails_if: threshold figure changes

verified.quote: This is insurance that you take out for your client on works over $16,000. It was previously known as 'builders warranty insurance'.

entries.claim: Low-rise gutters and downpipes governed by NCC 2022 Housing Provisions Part 7.4
entries.fails_if: a newer NCC edition supersedes 2022, or Pt 7.4 is renumbered

verified.quote: Part 7.4 Gutters and downpipes

entries.claim: Box gutters are carved out of the deemed-to-satisfy path via clause H2D6(3) of NCC 2022 Volume Two
entries.fails_if: provision reference changes

verified.quote: An important change is set out in clause H2D6(3). It excludes box gutters from Part 7.4.

entries.claim: Consumer guarantees under the Australian Consumer Law (Sch 2, Competition and Consumer Act 2010) apply alongside Victorian warranties and cannot be excluded by contract
entries.fails_if: ACL's non-excludability of these guarantees changes

verified.quote: These are called ‘warranties’ in the Domestic Building Contracts Act 1995, and ‘consumer guarantees’ in the Australian Consumer Law.
